name: Caribbean Sea
genZNote: The Caribbean Sea is the Panama Canal's front porch — most Atlantic-Pacific traffic passes right through or past it on the way to the canal.

sections.heading: 🌊 Location & Ocean Connection
bullets: A sea of the western Atlantic Ocean, bounded by Central America to the west, South America to the south, and the arc of Caribbean island nations to the north and east.
Connects to the Gulf of Mexico in the northwest and, via the Panama Canal, to the Pacific Ocean.

sections.heading: 🗺️ Countries Bordering It
bullets: Central America: Mexico (partly), Belize, Honduras, Nicaragua, Costa Rica, Panama.
Island nations: Cuba, Jamaica, Haiti, the Dominican Republic, Puerto Rico, Trinidad and Tobago, and many smaller island states.

sections.heading: 🚢 Ports & Trade Routes
bullets: The Panama Canal, at its south-western edge, is one of the most strategically important waterways in the world, linking the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans.
Major ports: Colon (Panama), Cartagena (Colombia), Kingston (Jamaica), and San Juan (Puerto Rico).
A major hub for cruise tourism as well as cargo shipping, given its role as a Panama Canal approach route.

sections.heading: 🐠 Economic & Ecological Significance
bullets: Home to significant coral reef systems, particularly around the Mesoamerican Reef (Mexico/Belize/Guatemala/Honduras) — the second-largest barrier reef system in the world after Australia's Great Barrier Reef.
A major tourism economy for many bordering island nations, closely tied to reef health and beach ecosystems.
Vulnerable to hurricanes, which regularly form or intensify over its warm waters.

quickRevision.oneLineDefinition: The Caribbean Sea is a sea of the western Atlantic between Central America, South America and the Caribbean islands, leading into the Panama Canal.
keyFacts: Sea of the western Atlantic Ocean.
Borders Central America, northern South America, and Caribbean island nations.
Panama Canal sits at its south-western edge.
Mesoamerican Reef — world's second-largest barrier reef system.
commonConfusion: The Caribbean Sea and the Gulf of Mexico are adjacent but distinct bodies of water, not the same sea.

highYieldFacts: Caribbean Sea = western Atlantic; borders Central America, South America, Caribbean islands.
Panama Canal connects it (and the Atlantic) to the Pacific.
Mesoamerican Reef = second-largest barrier reef system on Earth.
commonTraps: Don't call the Panama Canal a strait — it's an artificial, engineered canal, not a natural strait.
mustRemember: Caribbean Sea = Panama Canal's Atlantic-side approach; major reef and tourism region.
